resolution.tooltip: Long side the frames are resized to for C-RADIO, which gives one feature per 16x16 patch. Higher shows finer detail and needs more VRAM.

reference_frame.tooltip: Frame the reference mask belongs to.

sharpness.tooltip: Steepness of subject_mask: sigmoid(sharpness x (similarity to the subject - similarity to the background)).

batch_size.tooltip: Frames per C-RADIO batch. Lowered automatically when it would not fit in the free VRAM.

reference_mask.tooltip: Subject mask on reference_frame, white = subject (a hint or a keyed alpha). One mask, or one per frame (the one at reference_frame is used). Without it subject_mask is all zeros.

output_tooltips: C-RADIO features as colors (3-component PCA, fitted once per clip).
Similarity to the reference subject, 1 = subject. All zeros when no reference_mask is connected.
CorridorKey2SemanticIdentity.name: CorridorKey2SemanticIdentity
CorridorKey2SemanticIdentity.description: Shows how C-RADIO, the keyer's semantic foundation model, sees the clip: its features as a PCA color video (same color = same kind of thing; colors are fitted once per clip so they stay stable) and, given a subject mask on one frame, a soft mask of everything that resembles the subject on every frame. Use it to check that the model can tell the subject from the background, or as a rough hint for the keyer.
